anon.blurb: Your answers are never linked back to your account. Not by ID, not by email — by nothing at all.
anon.preSubmit: Before you send: your answers are stored with no link to your account. Nobody can tell which ones were yours.

signup.heading: Get set up
signup.intro: Email and phone are both needed — it's how we keep one person to one vote. Neither is ever attached to your answers.
signup.privacy: Your email and phone are only ever stored as one-way hashes — they cannot be read back.

verify.heading: Check your email
verify.intro: Punch in the six-digit code we just sent and your account is live.
verify.footnote: Codes last 15 minutes and work once. Check your spam folder if nothing lands.
verify.strandedHint: Your account already exists and just needs this code. If you lose this page, sign in as usual with your email and password — you will land straight back here.
verify.verifiedBody: Your address is confirmed and your account is active. Sign in and the survey is all yours.

login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Welcome back. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
login.signedInBody: Signed in and ready. The survey takes about two minutes.

gate.heading: Sign in first
gate.body: The survey is one response per account, so we need you signed in before you start.

profile.heading: Your pass
profile.intro: Your account, your survey status, and the code you show at the door.
profile.readyBody: Show this at the door. Staff scan it from their own device and hand you your benefit.
profile.notEligibleHeading: Not eligible to claim QR code
profile.notEligibleBody: Your pass appears here the moment your survey is in. It takes about two minutes.
profile.redeemedBody: This account's benefit has already been handed over. There is nothing left to scan.
profile.privacy: Your pass proves only that this account voted. It carries no name, no email and none of your answers.
profile.gateBody: Your pass and your account details live behind sign-in, so only you can see them.
profile.loadError: Could not load your account. Check your connection and try again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · Culture Fest 2026
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.translationNote: This policy is published in English and Greek. Where the two differ, the English text is the authoritative version.

notFound.title: Not found · Culture Fest 2026
notFound.heading: This page could not be found.
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. Everything else is where you left it.

admin.title: Culture Fest Admin
admin.loadError: Could not load this data. Check your connection and try again.

lookup.heading: Account lookup
lookup.intro: Look up an account by the reference on its profile to check its door status. A fallback for when the scanner cannot confirm a pass.
lookup.searchHint: Enter the account reference the visitor shows on their profile. A partial reference matches more accounts.
lookup.empty: Enter a reference above to search.
lookup.truncated: Showing the first {limit}; narrow the reference to see fewer.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.graphHint: Running totals over the last {window}. The gap between the lines is people who signed up but have not answered.
overview.participationHint: Share of all accounts that have submitted a survey.

responses.heading: Responses
responses.intro: Every answer, filterable. Responses carry no link back to an account.
responses.multiHint: Multiple choices allowed, so the shares add up to more than 100%.

values.title: The numbers
values.hint: Every option and its count, including options nobody picked.
values.question: Question

admins.heading: Admins
admins.intro: Who can reach this dashboard, and how to add someone.
admins.privacy: Accounts store only a one-way hash of the email address and phone number, so there is no name or address to show here — for you or for anyone else.
admins.listHint: References and dates only. There is nothing else on record.
admins.promoteHint: Give admin access to someone who already signed up. Their address is matched against the stored hash — check the reference you get back against the list above.
admins.promoteEmailHint: Must be an account that has already verified its email.
admins.promoteFailed: Could not promote that account. Please try again.
admins.createHint: The new account is created straight away but cannot sign in until the emailed code is entered — the same rule every account follows.
admins.createFailed: Could not create the account. Please try again.

placeholders.feedback: Tell us what would make this worth your night out.

already.heading: You've already answered
already.body: This account's response is in, and it is one response per account.
already.notice: There is nothing left to fill in. Your door pass is waiting on your pass page.

done.heading: That's it
done.body: Your answers are in. Thanks for helping shape the night.
done.confirmation: Response submitted. It is stored with no link back to your account — we cannot tell which answers were yours.

errors.phoneDigits: Phone number must contain between 7 and 15 digits.
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.passwordLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from your email.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the six-digit code from your email.

audience_type.title: Which one's you?
audience_type.description: Pick the closest fit — it sets what we ask next.

interest_level.title: How keen are you on a night like this?
interest_level.description: 1 is 'not my thing', 10 is 'tell me where to be'.

ticket_price_range.title: What would you pay?
ticket_price_range.description: For a full night, lineup announced.

transport_interest.title: Would you use shuttle transport?
transport_interest.note: Transport is €2 flat for visitors. Students with a valid pass travel free.

accommodation_area.title: Where are you staying?
accommodation_area.warning: Few people answer from any one area, so this could make your response identifiable. Leave it blank to stay anonymous.

has_student_pass.title: Do you have a student transport pass?
has_student_pass.note: Students with a valid pass travel free. Everyone else pays €2 flat.

open_feedback.title: Anything else?
open_feedback.description: Artists you want, things to avoid — all of it helps.
